title.zh: DiffuSpace把Qwen3.6改成扩散模型，GB300单卡跑出680 Token/s
title.en: DiffuSpace把Qwen3.6改成扩散模型，GB300单卡跑出680 Token/s

current_state.zh: DiffuSpace, founded by HKU professor Kong Lingpeng, open-sourced Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a block-diffusion language model rebuilt from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B that generates a chunk of text per step via parallel prediction and iterative refinement, claiming leading agent scores among diffusion models and up to 680 tok/s on a single GB300.
